title: Smartagri Researchers Win Best Presenter Award at 2026 National Agrotropical Seminar
excerpt: By: Fahmi Arsyad Yogyakarta, April 30, 2026. body:
By: Fahmi Arsyad

Yogyakarta, April 30, 2026. Researchers from the Smart Agriculture Research Center (Smartagri), Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering (DTPB), Faculty of Agricultural Technology Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM), successfully won the Best Presenter award at the 2026 National Agrotropical Seminar held by the Faculty of Agriculture at Universitas Mulawarman online via Zoom Meeting on Thursday, April 30, 2026. The national seminar carried the theme "Technology Transformation and Agricultural Innovation for Food Security and Sustainable Agriculture." The event was attended by academics, researchers, and students from various universities across Indonesia.

At the event, the Smartagri research team presented various research results focusing on the development of precision agriculture technology and smart systems to support production efficiency and agricultural resource management. The research presented took a data-driven approach through the integration of digital technology, control systems, and machine learning-based modeling to support decision-making in modern agricultural sectors. Through this presentation, the research team also introduced the development of technology that supports a more efficient and sustainable agricultural system.

Several research titles presented at the national seminar include:

-   _Development of Fuzzy Logic Algorithms for Irrigation Optimization on Sandy Land Based on Evapotranspiration and Soil Moisture_ by Ardan Desta Vaunendra
-   _Evaluation of Sprinkler Irrigation Implementation through Hydraulic Analysis and Water Distribution Uniformity Analysis Based on Christiansen Uniformity in Glagah Coastal Land, Kulon Progo_ by Devi Ramdani
-   _Quantification of External Factors as Basis for Operator Performance Evaluation in the Sapon Irrigation Area_ by Arinda Fadea Pramaesela
-   _Estimation of Rice Stomatal Conductance Using XGBoost Algorithm Based on Multispectral Imagery from Unmanned Aerial Vehicle_ by Faiz Ridwan Pratama
-   Classification of Papaya Plant Health Based on Machine Learning from Leaf Physiology Data by Muhammad Ilham Al Marda.

Based on the presentations delivered, Ardan Desta Vaunendra, Devi Ramdani, Arinda Fadea Pramaesela, and Ilham Al Marda successfully obtained the Best Presenter 1 award, while Faiz Ridwan Pratama received the Best Presenter 2 award. The awards were given based on the quality of material delivery, research substance, and the ability to answer questions during the discussion session. This achievement serves as motivation for the research team to continue developing the quality of research and scientific communication in the future.

The students involved in this research are under the guidance of Dr. Murtiningrum and Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho from the Smart Agriculture Research Center, Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada. This research activity is funded through the Priority Research Downstream Program – SINERGI Kemendikbudristekdikti 2025 as support for the development of innovative research in smart farming and sustainable agriculture.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-2-room_16-best_presenter_1-muhammad_ilham_al_marda-1-1030x728.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-3-room_14-best_presenter_1-arinda_fadea_pramaesela-1-1030x728.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-4-room_9-best_presenter_2-faiz_ridwan_pratama-1-1030x728.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-5-room_26-best_presenter_1-ardan_desta_vaunendra-1-1030x728.webp)

Participation and achievements at this seminar demonstrate Smartagri's commitment to advancing research development relevant to the needs of the modern agricultural sector. The national seminar also served as a means to expand academic collaboration and exchange of ideas among researchers in the field of smart farming and sustainable agriculture. Furthermore, the event supported the strengthening of academic culture and scientific publication within the higher education community.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-6-whatsapp-image-2026-04-30-at-1.16.16-pm-1030x579.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-7-whatsapp-image-2026-04-30-at-1.33.24-pm-1030x579.webp)

Research activities and participation in this seminar are supported by the **Sinergi** Program and the Food Security Working Group (**WGFS 1.2**) Precision Agriculture and Smart Farming, Inter-University Excellence Center (**PUAPT**) Universitas Gadjah Mada, which provided research facility support. This activity also contributes to the achievement of **SDG 2 (Zero Hunger)**, **SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure)**, and **SDG 13 (Climate Action)**. The development of agricultural technology innovation being conducted is expected to support the efficiency and sustainability of agricultural production systems in the future.

original.title: Peneliti Smartagri Raih Penghargaan Best Presenter pada Seminar Nasional Agrotropikal 2026
original.excerpt: Oleh : Fahmi Arsyad Yogyakarta, 30 April 2026 — Peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center (Smartagri), Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem (DTPB), Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM), berhasil meraih penghargaan Best Presenter dalam kegiatan Seminar Nasional Agrotropikal 2026 yang diselenggarakan oleh Fakultas Pertanian…
original.body:
Oleh : Fahmi Arsyad

Yogyakarta, 30 April 2026 — Peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center (Smartagri), Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem (DTPB), Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM), berhasil meraih penghargaan Best Presenter dalam kegiatan Seminar Nasional Agrotropikal 2026 yang diselenggarakan oleh Fakultas Pertanian Universitas Mulawarman secara daring melalui Zoom Meeting pada Kamis, 30 April 2026. Seminar nasional ini mengangkat tema “Transformasi Teknologi dan Inovasi Pertanian untuk Ketahanan Pangan dan Pertanian Berkelanjutan.” Kegiatan tersebut diikuti oleh akademisi, peneliti, dan mahasiswa dari berbagai perguruan tinggi di Indonesia.

Dalam kegiatan tersebut, tim peneliti Smartagri mempresentasikan berbagai hasil penelitian yang berfokus pada pengembangan teknologi pertanian presisi dan smart systems untuk mendukung efisiensi produksi serta pengelolaan sumber daya pertanian. Penelitian yang dipresentasikan mengangkat pendekatan berbasis data melalui integrasi teknologi digital, sistem kendali, dan pemodelan berbasis machine learning dalam mendukung pengambilan keputusan di sektor pertanian modern. Melalui presentasi tersebut, tim peneliti turut memperkenalkan pengembangan teknologi yang mendukung sistem pertanian yang lebih efisien dan berkelanjutan.

Beberapa judul penelitian yang dipresentasikan dalam seminar nasional tersebut antara lain:

-   _Pengembangan Algoritma Fuzzy Logic untuk Optimasi Irigasi Lahan Pasir Berdasarkan Evapotranspirasi dan Lengas Tanah_ oleh Ardan Desta Vaunendra
-   _Evaluasi Penerapan Irigasi Sprinkler melalui Analisis Hidraulik dan Analisis Keseragaman Distribusi Air Berbasis Christiansen Uniformity di Lahan Pantai Glagah, Kulon Progo_ oleh Devi Ramdani
-   _Kuantifikasi Faktor Eksternal Sebagai Dasar Evaluasi Kinerja Operator di Daerah Irigasi Sapon_ oleh Arinda Fadea Pramaesela
-   _Estimasi Konduktansi Stomata Padi Menggunakan Algoritma XGBoost Berbasis Citra Multispektral Unmanned Aerial Vehicle_ oleh Faiz Ridwan Pratama
-   Klasifikasi Kesehatan Tanaman Pepaya Berbasis Machine Learningdari Data Fisiologi Daun oleh Muhammad Ilham Al Marda.

Atas presentasi yang disampaikan, Ardan Desta Vaunendra, Devi Ramdani, Arinda Fadea Pramaesela, dan Ilham Al Marda berhasil memperoleh penghargaan Best Presenter 1, sementara Faiz Ridwan Pratama meraih penghargaan Best Presenter 2. Penghargaan tersebut diberikan berdasarkan kualitas penyampaian materi, substansi penelitian, serta kemampuan menjawab pertanyaan dalam sesi diskusi. Pencapaian ini menjadi motivasi bagi tim peneliti untuk terus mengembangkan kualitas riset dan komunikasi ilmiah ke depannya.

Mahasiswa yang terlibat dalam penelitian ini berada di bawah bimbingan Dr. Murtiningrum dan Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho dari Smart Agriculture Research Center, Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian, Universitas Gadjah Mada. Kegiatan penelitian ini didanai melalui Program Hilirisasi Riset Prioritas – SINERGI Kemendikbudristekdikti Tahun 2025 sebagai bentuk dukungan terhadap pengembangan riset inovatif di bidang smart farming dan pertanian berkelanjutan.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-1-room_23-best_presenter_1-devi_ramdani-1-1-1030x728.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-2-room_16-best_presenter_1-muhammad_ilham_al_marda-1-1030x728.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-3-room_14-best_presenter_1-arinda_fadea_pramaesela-1-1030x728.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-4-room_9-best_presenter_2-faiz_ridwan_pratama-1-1030x728.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-5-room_26-best_presenter_1-ardan_desta_vaunendra-1-1030x728.webp)

Partisipasi dan capaian dalam seminar ini menunjukkan komitmen Smartagri dalam mendorong pengembangan riset yang relevan dengan kebutuhan sektor pertanian modern. Seminar nasional ini juga menjadi sarana untuk memperluas kolaborasi akademik dan pertukaran gagasan antar peneliti di bidang smart farming dan pertanian berkelanjutan. Selain itu, kegiatan ini turut mendukung penguatan budaya akademik dan publikasi ilmiah di lingkungan perguruan tinggi.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-6-whatsapp-image-2026-04-30-at-1.16.16-pm-1030x579.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/691-7-whatsapp-image-2026-04-30-at-1.33.24-pm-1030x579.webp)

Kegiatan penelitian dan partisipasi dalam seminar ini didukung oleh Program **Sinergi** serta Working Group Food Security (**WGFS 1.2**) Precision Agriculture and Smart Farming, Pusat Unggulan Antar Perguruan Tinggi (**PUAPT**) Universitas Gadjah Mada, yang menyediakan dukungan fasilitas penelitian. Kegiatan ini juga berkontribusi terhadap pencapaian **SDG 2 (Zero Hunger)**, **SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure)**, dan **SDG 13 (Climate Action)**. Pengembangan inovasi teknologi pertanian yang dilakukan diharapkan dapat mendukung efisiensi dan keberlanjutan sistem produksi pertanian di masa mendatang.
